title: Produced-dataset config.toml sidecar — spec-v2.1
description: JSON Schema for the JSON projection of a produced artifact's config.toml sidecar: the re-hashable key table (every root key except [_META]) plus a [_META] block carrying cachetype and hash. Parse the TOML to JSON, then validate. Hash-input values are restricted to strings, integers, booleans, and arrays/objects of those (floats and nulls are disallowed).

hash.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 over the canonical-JSON projection of the key table.

hashValue.description: A hash-input value: string, integer, boolean, or an array/object composed of those. Floats and nulls are disallowed in hash inputs.
